About the Position

A fully funded PhD in the Department of Materials focusing on microstructurally informed modelling of metal fragmentation.

OpportunityFully Funded PhD Studentship: Microstructurally Informed Modelling of Metal Fragmentation
HostUniversity of Manchester
LocationManchester, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded
Stipend£21,805 per year (tax-free, UKRI 2026/27 rate)
Application DeadlineCheck departmental page
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Basic Information

  • Full Project Title: PhD Studentship: Microstructurally Informed Modelling of Metal Fragmentation
  • Host Institution: The University of Manchester
  • Department: Department of Materials
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Duration: 3.5 years
  • Start Date: 2026/27
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: £21,805 (2026/27 UKRI minimum) per year (tax-free, UKRI 2026/27 rate)
  • Tuition Fees: Covered
  • Eligibility: Home students (UK)
  • Application Deadline: Check departmental page

Project Overview

This fully funded 3.5-year PhD project develops microstructurally informed computational models of metal fragmentation - linking a metal’s microstructure (grain structure, phases, defects) to how metallic components break apart under loading. The work sits in the Department of Materials at the University of Manchester and combines materials modelling with validation against experimental data. The full project description and supervisor details are given on the departmental application page linked below.

Funding and Duration

The studentship runs for 3.5 years and is fully funded for home (UK) students: the annual tax-free stipend is set at the UKRI doctoral minimum for 2026/27 - £21,805 - and tuition fees are covered. The start date is the 2026/27 academic year. International applicants should check the departmental page in case later rounds open up additional fee support.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.se.manchester.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-research/getting-started/applying/

Source: se.manchester.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Check departmental page - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About University of Manchester

The University of Manchester is a public research university in Manchester, England, and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across engineering, science, medicine, business and the humanities. Its research community connects academic discovery with challenges in health, sustainability, technology and society through collaboration.

Official website: https://www.manchester.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Apply via the jobs.ac.uk link provided.
